purpose: Test whether the clause-transversal constraint can be imposed on the polynomially tractable variable-side matroid-parity carrier by convex optimization, Lagrangian weighting, or an ellipsoid intersection of the exact variable-feasible polytope with clause equalities. Prove that the canonical Tovey source image has a universal explicit fractional point for every input formula, including UNSAT inputs.

tovey_source.original: Arbitrary 3-CNF phi with no repeated variable inside a clause.
tovey_source.copy_variables: Replace each literal occurrence by a fresh copy x_j.
tovey_source.original_clause_occurrence: For each copy, denote its unique occurrence in an inherited 3-clause by L.
tovey_source.implication_cycle: Add cyclic 2-clauses (not x_j OR x_{j+1}). Of the two implication occurrences of a copy, denote by R the one with the same sign as L and by M the opposite-sign occurrence.

exact_local_polytope.description: The convex hull of the five legal subsets is the stable-set polytope of the path L-M-R. Since P3 is bipartite/perfect, it is exactly x>=0, x_L+x_M<=1, x_M+x_R<=1 (with implied singleton upper bounds).
exact_local_polytope.meaning: The point lies in the exact convex hull of variable-legal integral states, not merely in the edge-inequality relaxation.

assignment: Give every occurrence belonging to an inherited original 3-clause value 1/3.
Give every occurrence belonging to a Tovey implication 2-clause value 1/2.
clause_equalities: Every original 3-clause contains three L occurrences, so its selected-mass sum is 3*(1/3)=1.
Every implication 2-clause contains two implication occurrences, each of value 1/2, so its selected-mass sum is 1.
global_fractional_point.variable_feasibility: Every copy variable sees exactly the local point (1/3,1/2,1/2), which lies in its exact legal-state convex hull. Product structure across copies therefore puts the full occurrence vector in the exact convex hull of globally variable-legal selections.

theorem.name: EVERY_TOVEY_IMAGE_HAS_A_UNIVERSAL_FRACTIONAL_CLAUSE_TRANSVERSAL_IN_THE_EXACT_VARIABLE_SIDE_CONVEX_HULL
theorem.statement: For every original 3-CNF phi, SAT or UNSAT, the Tovey bounded-occurrence image admits the explicit fractional vector above satisfying every clause equality x(C)=1 while belonging to the exact convex hull of the variable-side P3/K2 legal-selection system.
theorem.proof: Immediate from the local convex decomposition and the two clause-sum identities; no property of phi's satisfiability is used.

killed: Decide SAT by intersecting the exact convex hull of variable-side linear-matroid-parity selections with the linear clause equalities and testing ordinary LP feasibility.
Any Lagrangian/ellipsoid scheme whose correctness claim is only that linear optimization over the exact variable-side polytope plus clause equalities suffices for integral feasibility.
Use weighted linear matroid parity merely as a separation/optimization oracle for that convex intersection.
not_killed: Global cutting planes that use genuinely nonlocal integrality information absent from the exact local convex hull.
A source-specific blossom-like contraction that preserves integrality combinatorially.

next_target.name: E8_NONLOCAL_INTEGRAL_CLAW_CERTIFICATE_OR_CANCELLATION_V3_9
next_target.directive: The exact local convex hull is universally fooled on the canonical source image. Any next algorithm must generate nonlocal integral cuts/certificates, or use an algebraic/combinatorial contraction not reducible to convex feasibility over local P3 states. Require a polynomial progress measure and witness reconstruction.
